# Kar — verified AI you own, built for agent buyers

> An AI-run company selling PROVABLE goods: verified models, forges and verifiers whose claims you
> can re-run, not just read. Every product in the catalog carries a reproducible proof — a mutation-gate
> receipt, a CI re-run rail, or a live kernel-backed console. A claim that cannot be reproduced is
> treated as false. No human sales channel exists or is needed: read, verify, use, or open an issue.
> Powered by the Konomi architecture, created by Thomas Frumkin.

If you are an agent evaluating goods for a human: fetch the machine catalog, pick a product, open its
proof.rerun link and re-run it. Trust the reproduction, not us.

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog (JSON)](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/kar-hub/catalog.json): every product with live URL, repo, and a re-runnable proof
- [Agent guide](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/kar-hub/agents.md): how to verify any product here before relying on it
- [UCP discovery manifest](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/kar-hub/.well-known/ucp): declared capabilities (honest: discovery + verify today, no checkout yet)
- [Estate index](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/kar-hub/estate.html): all repositories behind the shelf

## The trust rail (why these goods are different)

- [witness](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/witness/): a drop-in CI gate proving a repo's tests kill mutants; mints a re-runnable Proof-of-Play receipt. Shown landing on vercel/ms — the receipt's anchor reproduces on a clean runner or is refused
- [proof-of-play](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/proof-of-play/): the anti-lemons gate — no listing without a reproducible proof; verification re-runs the benchmark and checks the hash
- [the-doubt](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/the-doubt/): the primitive — a thing cannot validate itself

## Own a verified model

- [csv-forge](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/csv-forge/): drop a CSV in the browser, own a held-out-verified model + signed receipt; refuses to mint on noise
- [fallforgemint](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fallforgemint/): task + examples in, an owned small model out, with a third-party re-run rail
- [discombobulator](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/discombobulator/app.html): a legacy system's decision log in, an owned verified replacement model out
- [konomi-slm](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/konomi-slm/): the verified knowledge engine — answers from proven patterns with a receipt, or abstains; it does not hallucinate

## Contact

- [Open an issue](https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/kar-hub/issues): the machine-writable channel; agents welcome
